events.text: I'll start by checking whether the Day 0 r5 run is still moving and what the harness expects, then pick up from the first unreviewed card.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check Day 0 r5 log freshness and tests dir
events.input: $ ls -la revops-os/tests/ 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "---LOG TAIL---"; wc -l revops-os/tests/runs-d0-r5.log 2>/dev/null; echo "---MTIME---"; stat -f "%Sm %N" -t "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S" revops-os/tests/runs-d0-r5.log 2>/dev/null; echo "---NOW---"; date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z"

events.name: Bash
events.head: List harness scripts and plan size
events.input: $ ls revops-os/os/scripts/ revops-os/tests/ 2>/dev/null | head -100; echo "==== PLAN HEAD ===="; wc -l workshop-plan/REVOPS_OS_PLAN_2026_10_15.md revops-os/os/BRIEF.md 2>/dev/null

events.text: The log was last written 3 minutes ago, so the run may still be alive. Let me read the log and check for a live process.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read r5 log and check live processes
events.input: $ cat revops-os/tests/runs-d0-r5.log; echo "=== PROCESSES ==="; ps aux | grep -E "run.py|claude" | grep -v grep | head -30

events.text: The log is still growing. Let me see the tail and whether the harness process is alive.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Tail r5 log and find harness process
events.input: $ tail -c 1500 revops-os/tests/runs-d0-r5.log; echo; echo "=== RUN.PY PROCS ==="; ps -o pid,etime,command -ax | grep -E "run.py" | grep -v grep | cut -c1-220

events.text: The r5 harness is alive (pid 4833, running 14 min) and is waiting out a rate-limit window. Let me understand the harness so I can work in parallel on the review and fix side.

The harness runs cards sequentially and reviews in a pool. Let me check the current state of the r5 results to see how far it has gotten.
The results file doesn't hold the verdicts. Let me find where reviews are stored.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate review outputs
events.input: $ ls revops-os/tests/runs/d0-r5/log/ | head -60; echo "=== review files ==="; ls revops-os/tests/runs/d0-r5/log/ | grep -c review; echo "=== grep review key in run.py ==="; grep -n "review" revops-os/tests/run.py | head -40
